purpose: Fresh reference-blind CPU candidate that isolates and repairs the V158 timebase architecture failure before any new pitch-model tuning. V159 keeps the V158 Guitar and Bass recognition configurations unchanged in substance and changes the musical coordinate system, pre-candidate timebase QC, and separation of beat ordinal from bar phase.

allowedInheritance: beat-tracker input must be finite and nonnegative
absolute beat ordinal must be independent of bar-phase inference
timebase must pass reference-blind sanity QC before candidate emission
rhythm/timebase runtime warnings must be fatal before candidate authority
pitch thresholds must not be tuned from V158 score

song.title: Are You Gonna Go My Way

triggerSafety.ifDuplicateRunDetected: abort V159 without candidate/scoring and move to a fresh version

timebase.architecture: materialize-and-QC a standalone reference-blind timebase artifact before any Guitar/Bass event generation; the candidate transcriber consumes that exact frozen timebase artifact instead of recomputing beat/bar structure

beatEnvelope.drumsFeature: librosa onset_strength on Demucs drums stem
beatEnvelope.perFeatureTransform: clamp finite onset strength to >=0, then divide by its finite positive maximum; all-zero feature fails timebase construction
beatEnvelope.requiredDomain: finite, nonnegative, at least one strictly positive sample

beatTracker.method: librosa.beat.beat_track on the finite nonnegative fused envelope
beatTracker.runtimeWarnings: record all warnings in the beat/rhythm stage and fail before candidate emission on RuntimeWarning, NaN, or Inf
beatTracker.acceptedBeatOrder: strictly increasing detected beat times only

absoluteBeatOrdinal.principle: one accepted tracked beat always advances absolute beat ordinal by exactly one

barPhase.method: choose one static four-beat phase from audio accent evidence; phase labels do not alter beat times or beat ordinal
evidenceFeatures: drums onset-strength robust z-score at accepted beat
normalized-mix onset-strength robust z-score at accepted beat
bass-stem onset-strength robust z-score at accepted beat
low-frequency spectral-flux robust z-score at accepted beat
harmonic chroma-change novelty robust z-score at accepted beat
barPhase.phaseScore: mean weighted accent evidence on beats assigned phase-0/downbeat minus mean weighted accent evidence on all other beats
barPhase.tieBreak: lowest phase index within numeric tolerance

musicalOrigin.principle: measure 1 begins at the phase-consistent downbeat at or immediately before the first accepted tracked beat; no professional-reference shift is used
musicalOrigin.earlyPeriod: median of the first up-to-eight positive detected inter-beat intervals
musicalOrigin.prefix: if leadingBeatCount > 0, extrapolate exactly that many beat positions backward from the first accepted beat using earlyPeriod

gridInterpolation.method: piecewise-linear interpolation through prefix plus accepted detected beat times
gridInterpolation.measureMapping: fixed 16 sixteenth steps per generated measure for the front-end candidate; no professional-reference meter map is consumed by generation

checks: timebase artifact schema and exact audio/stem identities
fused beat envelope provenance declares finite/nonnegative construction
at least eight accepted detected beats
beat times finite and strictly increasing
all inter-beat intervals finite and positive
median inter-beat interval implies BPM between 30 and 300 inclusive
mean inter-beat interval implies BPM between 30 and 300 inclusive
detected beat-count/duration implied BPM between 30 and 300 inclusive
observed median-IBI BPM divided by tracker tempo lies between 0.5 and 2.0 inclusive to tolerate ordinary half/double-tempo ambiguity but reject pathological divergence
absolute beat ordinal increments exactly by one across detected beats
raw grid is strictly increasing in time
requiredRecordedDiagnostics: selected bar phase and four phase scores
leading beat count and early extrapolation period
first/last grid time and grid step extent
preCandidateTimebaseQc.failurePolicy: any failure aborts V159 before authoritative candidate creation; freeze the failure receipt and do not re-arm V159

pitchRecognition.principle: isolate the timebase repair: Guitar and Bass recognition numerics remain unchanged from the sealed V158 numeric implementation contract unless a mechanical refactor is required to consume the V159 timebase artifact

guitar.architecture: Basic Pitch proposals plus persistent multi-frame harmonic-template additions and deterministic +/-12 register repair

bass.architecture: onset-first attacks plus pYIN soft evidence and harmonic-template pitch assignment

candidatePostProcessing.deduplicateSameStream: same MIDI and same snapped absolute grid step collapse to one event with deterministic evidence precedence

mustPassBeforeCandidateFreeze: exact audio/dependency/model identities and deterministic CPU environment
candidate write-once and single generation workflow run
all events finite and within preregistered MIDI ranges
all event raw grid positions agree with the frozen V159 timebase artifact
all snapped steps and measure mapping internally consistent
no prior generated candidate/score/diagnostic read by V159 runtime
no human correction, threshold sweep, or variant selection

failurePolicy: Any duplicate generation run, pre-candidate timebase-QC failure, structural-QC failure after candidate creation, or missed score gate freezes the V159 outcome and ends V159. Never repair/retune/select a replacement V159 candidate against the professional reference.
